content: We tokenize every question-context pair $(Q, C)$ with $\mathcal {T} = \mathcal {T}_\mathrm {LM}$ or $\mathcal {T} = \hat{\mathcal {T}}_\mathrm {LM}$, which yields $(\mathcal {T}(Q), \mathcal {T}(C))$. Since $\mathcal {T}(C)$ is usually too long to be digested in a single forward pass, we define a sliding window with width and stride $N = \mathrm {floor}(\frac{509 - |\mathcal {T}(Q)|}{2})$. At step $n$, the “active” window is between $a^{(l)}_n = nN$ and $a^{(r)}_n = \mathrm {min}(|C|, nN+N)$. The input is defined as:
